name: Waqoo Inc.
summary: Waqoo Inc., formed in 2005 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, formulates, produces and sells cosmetics in Japan. Its HADA NATURE brand, sold through its own e-commerce platform, includes moisturizing gels, cleansers, whitening serums and washes, protein-based products and makeup bases. It also offers advertising services and contract services for regenerative medicine, processing blood-derived and fat-derived stem cells.
